channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Panera Bread: BOGO5: Second Entree for $5
item.description: Enter code BOGO5 at checkout online or in the app to get a second full-size soup, salad, or sandwich for just $5 when you buy one entree; free MyPanera account required. (Limited time)

item.title: Top Pick: Chili's: 3 For Me Bundle from $10.99
item.description: Get a bottomless non-alcoholic drink, chips and salsa, and a full-size entree (your choice from about a dozen options) for $10.99; no code needed, just order in-restaurant or via the app. (Ongoing)

item.title: Top Pick: Subway: Any Footlong for $6.99
item.description: Use promo code FOOTLONG699 at online or app checkout to get any footlong sub for $6.99 at participating locations. (Through September 12, 2026)

item.title: Chili's: Shark Attack Margarita: $6 All August
item.description: Chili's featured margarita of the month is the Shark Attack Margarita at a flat $6, available every day in August at participating locations nationwide. (Through August 31, 2026)

item.title: Shake Shack: App Prices: $4 Fries and $2 Sodas
item.guid: Shake Shack-App Prices: $4 Fries and $2 Sodas-2026-08-19
item.description: Order through the Shake Shack app or website to unlock discounted pricing on fries ($4) and sodas ($2) at participating locations chainwide; the deal does not include limited-time shakes. (Ongoing)
